_doc: The Undertow's Reach (act1/undertows_reach.md; final pass M3-CRB-007): water (the forearm, the palm and the digits' cores: black storm-water, slate streaks, foam crests, the door-sized wounds), crust (the crust plates, claws and keel spurs, barnacles, the drowned spawn bodies), wreck (masts, yard, planks, the wheel, chain, rope, the lantern). wet_darken 0.55 on water (was 0.2, which crushed the vertex colours to black). The storm's own water look is the PC GPU session's; this is the creature-shader stand-in. Polish: crust is a dry, rough shell (roughness 0.8 dry / 0.32 wet, specular 0.35, clearcoat 0.3, a finer, deeper grain: detail scale 12, albedo 0.38, bump 2.0; was 0.45 / 0.15 / 0.5 / 0.8 and 5 / 0.3 / 1.2, which read as polished black facets), its wetness pooled in the plates' grooves and low ground by the vertex data. write_materials.py on game/shaders/creature/creature.gdshader.
